lines.text: Jesus crossed the Sea of Galilee, and a large crowd followed Him because they saw His signs on the sick.
Jesus asked Philip where to buy bread, and Philip said two hundred denarii would not buy enough.
Andrew pointed out a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish, and Jesus had the people sit down.
Jesus gave thanks and distributed the food, and the disciples filled seven baskets with leftover pieces.
The people called Him the Prophet, so Jesus withdrew to Jerusalem by Himself because they wanted to make Him king.
